title: Marketing CDK stack: bucket, distribution, /api* behavior, OIDC role

comments.author: home
comments.text:
CDK app in Chattic.us-web: S3 bucket, CloudFront distribution for chattic.us,
an /api* behavior pointing at the same thin-turn Lambda function URL with the
same X-Chatticus-Invoke-Key header pattern as infra/lib/web-stack.ts here, so
waitlist and contact posts stay same-origin with no code change to
lib/config.ts's apiBase. Reads the invoke secret from Secrets Manager in the
shared account. Issues its own ACM certificate for chattic.us + www.chattic.us,
DNS-validated against the existing hosted zone (which stays in this repo's
infra/lib/dns-stack.ts). New GitHub OIDC deploy role scoped to Chattic.us-web,
mirroring infra/lib/github-deploy-stack.ts.

Production only, per the answered question on this epic.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
CDK app written in Chattic.us-web@031354c: ChatticusMarketingGitHubDeploy (OIDC role, production only, sub-claim wildcarded to numeric ids matching AnthusAI/Chatticus's own convention) and ChatticusMarketing (S3 + CloudFront + /api* behavior). Hosted zone and cert reused via Fn.importValue(ChatticusDns-HostedZoneId/SiteCertificateArn) rather than a new cert. Thin-turn function-url and invoke-key-secret-arn resolved via ssm.StringParameter.valueForStringParameter (deploy-time dynamic reference, not a synth-time lookup, so cdk synth needs no AWS credentials -- verified). includeApexDomain prop (env CHATTICUS_MARKETING_INCLUDE_APEX) controls www-only vs www+apex, defaulting to www-only until cutover (chatticus-a83464).

Verified: infra npm test 5/5, cdk synth clean with no AWS creds.

Not yet deployed -- blocked on aws login (interactive browser auth this session cannot complete). Once available: sh deploy-chatticus-marketing-github-deploy.sh (bootstrap, local only, sets AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN production secret on the repo), then push to main deploys ChatticusMarketing via CI.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed a real bug found by Chattic.us-web's own first CI run: this app's root tsconfig.json globs **/*.ts from the repo root, which swept in infra/bin/chattic-us-web.ts and failed the Next.js build's typecheck phase on 'Cannot find module aws-cdk-lib' (infra/ has its own separate node_modules). Fixed by excluding infra/ from tsconfig.json and eslint.config.mjs (4b57605). Second CI run: green (build, typecheck, test, behave all pass). Deploy Marketing (production) reached exactly the expected, benign stopping point -- Configure AWS credentials fails cleanly with no AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN secret set, since ChatticusMarketingGitHubDeploy hasn't been deployed yet (needs aws login, which this session cannot complete interactively).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Deployed. ChatticusMarketingGitHubDeploy role bootstrapped locally, AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN secret set on the repo's production environment, ChatticusMarketing deployed via CI (run 33927607653, success) after fixing an unrelated but real bug the deploy caught: the committed package-lock.json pinned an integrity hash for the chatticus tarball that went stale the moment this repo's own semantic-release pushed a version-bump commit to main -- npm install failed closed with EINTEGRITY. Fixed by not committing package-lock.json at all (the whole point of the dependency is that it's unpinned/always-current; a lockfile fights that). 

Verified live (chatticus-ef8371's guarantee): www.chattic.us and the raw CloudFront domain (d2jp75rstyi891.cloudfront.net) both serve 200s across /, /beta/, /wiki/. Same-origin /api* proxy confirmed end-to-end: GET /api/waitlist/survey returns the real survey schema (200), POST /api/waitlist and POST /api/contact both return {status: recorded} (201) against the real production thin-turn backend. Test email marketing-cutover-verification-test@example.com used for both -- flagging in case it needs cleanup from the waitlist/contact-lead tables before real operator review.
